name: Power of the Wilds
description: You gain one of the following options of your choice. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change your choice. Falcon - while your Rage is active, you have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed if you aren't wearing any armor. Lion - while your Rage is active, any of your enemies within 5 feet of you have Disadvantage on attack rolls against targets other than you or another Barbarian that has this option active. Ram - while your Rage is active, you can cause a creature to be pushed up to 15 feet away from you when you hit it with a melee attack and deal damage to it.

review.notes: authored from PHB 2024, mechanic not yet wired to activities
